overall_goal: Cook and stir the mushrooms in the pan

goals.description: Stir the mushrooms and retrieve fallen pieces
goals.rationale: The person stirs the mushrooms, picks up a piece that fell onto the hob, returns it to the pan, and continues stirring.

goals.description: Continue stirring the mushrooms and check the heat setting
goals.rationale: The person taps the spatula to release mushroom pieces, stirs and shakes the pan, checks the hob setting underneath, and resumes stirring.
